Local owner, commercial standards

I’m Austin Stickley, owner of Toledo Power Wash. This business is built to become a real commercial exterior vendor — not a weekend flyer operation. That means insurance, photo SOPs, recurring contracts, and clear communication with property managers.

Peak season in Ohio is spring through fall, when winter salt and grime hit sidewalks and pads hardest. We plan routes and packages around that reality.
